positions.name: MissingIdPipelineRequirement
positions.frame: how must the pipeline respond when a memory is submitted without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the precondition — a submission arriving without an explicit id — and src-2 mandates the pipeline's required response: generate a slug from memory content via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Together they form a complete pipeline-behavior specification for the missing-id case, read as a progression from observed condition to operational mandate rather than as a shared stance performed identically — the conviction gradient (claim to decision) is the specification's own shape, not a defect.
